g.title: G
cluster_micro
cluster_meso
cluster_macro

frag_micro_component_size → fright_micro_nearest_fright_distance intra_scale Belonging to a larger component increases the chance that a frightened neighbor is nearby, reducing the distance to the nearest frightened contact.
frag_micro_component_size → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale More neighbors in a larger component increase the social alignment pressure on a fish, raising alignment with nearby headings.
frag_micro_component_size → comp_micro_degree intra_scale A fish embedded in a larger connected component has more potential contact partners, so its realized contact degree tends to be higher.

frag_micro_component_size → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Larger connected components usually arise from denser local spacing, which reduces the distance to the nearest contact neighbor.

frag_micro_component_size → lead_micro_influence_score intra_scale Fish in larger components have more opportunities to affect neighbors' future turns, which can raise their run-level lagged influence score.

frag_micro_component_shark_distance → frag_micro_isolate intra_scale A component centroid closer to a shark can intensify local avoidance and detachment of fringe fish, making focal contact isolation more likely.
frag_micro_component_shark_distance → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale A closer shark near the component centroid can evoke stronger focal turning responses, increasing step heading change.

frag_micro_component_shark_distance → pol_micro_heading_deviation intra_scale Threat near a component can pull focal headings away from the school mean as individuals prioritize escape, increasing heading deviation.

frag_micro_component_shark_distance → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Threat proximity to a component centroid can compress or loosen local spacing as fish adjust repulsion and attraction, altering nearest-contact distance.

elong_micro_major_projection → frag_micro_isolate intra_scale Fish at extreme projections along the school's major axis are more likely to be spatially peripheral, making them more susceptible to contact loss and isolation.

elong_micro_major_projection → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Position along the major axis can correlate with local social conditions; peripheral fish may experience weaker neighbor alignment than central fish.
elong_micro_mahalanobis_sq → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale Peripheral position relative to the school covariance can require larger corrective turns, increasing focal heading change.

elong_micro_mahalanobis_sq → pol_micro_heading_deviation intra_scale Peripheral fish with large whole-school Mahalanobis distance may be less constrained by the main school direction and deviate more from mean heading.

elong_micro_mahalanobis_sq → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale A focal fish far from the school centroid can have weaker local directional coupling to its contact neighbors, reducing neighbor alignment.

elong_micro_mahalanobis_sq → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Fish far from the school centroid in Mahalanobis distance are often peripheral and may experience different local spacing, changing nearest-contact distance.
elong_micro_component_projection → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Fish at elongation extremes may sample different neighbor sets, affecting heading alignment with contacts.
elong_micro_component_projection → comp_micro_degree intra_scale Position along a component axis can place fish in sparse peripheral zones, changing local contact opportunities and degree.

elong_micro_component_projection → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Fish near the ends of an elongated contact component may have fewer close contacts, altering nearest-neighbor spacing through local crowding geometry.
wave_micro_escape_alignment → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale When a fish heading is misaligned with its recorded escape direction, the needed adjustment implies a larger step heading change.

wave_micro_escape_alignment → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Strong individual alignment to an escape direction can reduce alignment with contact neighbors if those neighbors follow social rather than escape headings.

wave_micro_escape_alignment → mill_micro_angular_velocity intra_scale An escape direction oriented tangentially with respect to the school centroid can induce angular motion, raising focal angular velocity.
wave_micro_requested_turn_abs → wave_micro_escape_alignment intra_scale Large requested turns can rotate heading toward or away from the recorded escape direction, changing escape alignment.
wave_micro_requested_turn_abs → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale Requested turn sets the desired rotation; actual heading change results after turn-rate limits and random perturbation.
wave_micro_requested_turn_abs → pol_micro_heading_deviation intra_scale Turn requests redistribute headings relative to the school mean, altering focal heading deviation.
wave_micro_requested_turn_abs → mill_micro_tangential_speed intra_scale Turning changes velocity direction relative to the centroid, modifying the tangential component of motion.

wave_micro_heading_change → wave_micro_requested_turn_abs intra_scale A larger requested turn magnitude is the decision-level driver that produces a larger realized heading change, subject to turning limits.
wave_micro_heading_change → pol_micro_heading_deviation intra_scale A larger realized heading change can move a fish's orientation away from the school mean, increasing its angular deviation.

wave_micro_heading_change → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Rapid turning by a focal fish tends to reduce its heading alignment with contact neighbors as it departs from their average orientation.

wave_micro_heading_change → lead_micro_influence_score intra_scale Fish that make larger heading changes are more salient to neighbors and can more strongly trigger follow-on turns, increasing their lagged influence score.
fright_micro_state → wave_micro_requested_turn_abs intra_scale Fright alters the decision blend and escape bias, changing the magnitude of requested turn.
fright_micro_state → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale Frightened fish blend escape and social directions, producing different step-to-step heading changes.
fright_micro_state → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale A frightened fish's escape direction can reduce alignment with neighboring headings.
fright_micro_state → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Frightened movement can compress or separate local spacing, changing distance to the nearest contact neighbor.
fright_micro_remaining → wave_micro_requested_turn_abs intra_scale A longer fright state motivates stronger escape maneuvers, increasing the magnitude of requested turns toward the escape direction.
fright_micro_remaining → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale Frightened fish make sharper escape turns, so longer remaining fright tends to produce larger step-to-step heading changes.

fright_micro_remaining → pol_micro_heading_deviation intra_scale A longer remaining fright period sustains escape bias, which pulls a fish's heading away from the school mean and raises its deviation.
fright_micro_remaining → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Frightened fish prioritize escape over social alignment, so longer remaining fright reduces heading alignment with contact neighbors.
fright_micro_remaining → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Sustained fright enhances repulsion and escape spacing, increasing the distance to the nearest contact neighbor.
fright_micro_remaining → mill_micro_radial_velocity intra_scale A longer fright episode biases movement away from the school center, increasing the outward radial velocity component.

fright_micro_nearest_fright_distance → frag_micro_isolate intra_scale A frightened neighbor very close by can trigger escape maneuvers that break contact links, so smaller distance to a frightened neighbor can increase the chance of isolation.

fright_micro_nearest_fright_distance → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Close proximity to a frightened neighbor may divert attention to escape and disrupt heading alignment with the broader neighbor set, reducing neighbor alignment.

pol_micro_heading_deviation → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale A fish that is misaligned with the school mean experiences a social restoring torque, leading to a larger heading change to re-align.
pol_micro_heading_deviation → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Deviation from the global school heading makes a fish more likely to be misaligned with its local contact neighbors as well.

pol_micro_neighbor_alignment → frag_micro_isolate intra_scale Alignment with contact neighbors indicates membership in a cohesive local group; stronger neighbor alignment makes it less likely the fish is isolated.
pol_micro_neighbor_alignment → comp_micro_degree intra_scale Fish that are well aligned with their contact neighbors tend to move together and maintain or form more contacts, increasing their degree.
pol_micro_shark_proximity → wave_micro_escape_alignment intra_scale Closer shark proximity can strengthen escape priming, making focal heading more aligned with its escape direction.
pol_micro_shark_proximity → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale Greater shark proximity can trigger stronger turning responses, increasing the focal fish's step heading change.
pol_micro_shark_proximity → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Threat proximity can alter local compaction and repulsion, changing the distance to the nearest contact neighbor.

pol_micro_shark_proximity → mill_micro_angular_velocity intra_scale A nearby shark can induce turning and tangential motion around local neighbors or the school centroid, affecting focal angular velocity.

comp_micro_degree → frag_micro_isolate intra_scale A fish with more recorded contact neighbors is less likely to have zero contacts; degree directly reflects social embedding, so higher degree reduces the probability of isolation.

comp_micro_degree → fright_micro_nearest_fright_distance intra_scale More neighbors increase the chance that at least one frightened contact neighbor is nearby, reducing the minimum distance to a frightened neighbor.

comp_micro_degree → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale More contact neighbors provide more social cues for heading alignment; higher degree can increase the focal fish's alignment with the local neighbor mean heading.

comp_micro_degree → lead_micro_influence_percentile intra_scale Better-connected fish have more opportunities to affect neighbors' future heading changes, which can raise their run-level lagged influence percentile.

comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Closer contact spacing can strengthen local directional coupling, while larger spacing can weaken heading alignment with contact neighbors.
comp_micro_clustering_coefficient → frag_micro_component_size intra_scale Clustering can reinforce local contact loops that keep fish within the same connected component.
comp_micro_clustering_coefficient → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Dense triangles provide more mutually visible aligned neighbors, facilitating local heading alignment.
comp_micro_clustering_coefficient → lead_micro_lagged_alignment intra_scale Clustered neighborhoods transmit previous-step turns more consistently, affecting lagged following alignment.
mill_micro_angular_velocity → pol_micro_heading_deviation intra_scale Fish rotating around the school centroid tend to have headings distinct from the school mean, increasing heading deviation.
mill_micro_angular_velocity → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Rotational motion around the centroid can change local crowding and spacing, altering nearest-contact distance.
mill_micro_tangential_speed → pol_micro_heading_deviation intra_scale Strong tangential velocity implies heading not aligned with the radial or school-mean direction, raising deviation.
mill_micro_tangential_speed → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Tangential motion around the centroid changes local crowding and the spacing to nearest contacts.
mill_micro_radial_velocity → frag_micro_component_size intra_scale Outward radial motion increases spacing and can break contact links, reducing the size of the focal fish's connected component.

mill_micro_radial_velocity → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Radial motion is not aligned with the tangential social flow, so higher radial velocity tends to reduce heading alignment with neighbors.
mill_micro_radial_velocity → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale A stronger outward radial velocity moves a fish away from its neighbors, increasing the nearest contact distance.
lead_micro_lagged_alignment → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale Following neighbor turns shapes the current turn adjustment and thus the realized heading change.
lead_micro_lagged_alignment → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Successful lagged following aligns the focal heading with the current neighbor heading.
lead_micro_lagged_alignment → comp_micro_nearest_contact_distance intra_scale Following curved neighbor turns can close or open local spacing, changing nearest contact distance.
lead_micro_lagged_alignment → mill_micro_tangential_speed intra_scale Following curved neighbor turns can induce a tangential velocity component around the school centroid.
lead_micro_influence_score → wave_micro_heading_change intra_scale Fish with higher lagged influence scores tend to initiate more pronounced heading changes that propagate to neighbors.

lead_micro_influence_percentile → pol_micro_neighbor_alignment intra_scale Fish with high run-level influence may initiate direction changes and thus exhibit different instantaneous alignment with neighbors compared to followers.

lead_micro_influence_percentile → comp_micro_degree intra_scale Influential fish often occupy central network positions and may have more contact neighbors, linking higher influence percentile to higher degree.
frag_meso_mean_component_size → frag_meso_component_size_entropy intra_scale Larger mean components concentrate fish counts into fewer groups, altering component-size entropy.
frag_meso_mean_component_size → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Larger cohesive components can sustain shared heading, raising component heading polarization.
frag_meso_mean_component_size → comp_meso_component_mean_degree intra_scale Larger components expose fish to more potential contact neighbors, raising mean component degree.

frag_meso_component_size_entropy → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale When the school is split into diverse components, escape directions are less shared across the group, lowering escape coherence.

frag_meso_component_size_entropy → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Fragmentation into many differently sized components disrupts coherent group alignment, reducing component-level polarization.

frag_meso_component_size_entropy → comp_meso_component_edge_density intra_scale Higher diversity of component sizes indicates a more fragmented school, where within-component contacts are sparser and edge density is lower.
frag_meso_component_size_entropy → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale Fragmentation disrupts the coherent circular flow needed for milling, reducing rotational order within components.

frag_meso_centroid_pair_distance → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale When component centroids are more widely separated, components may receive less shared directional information, reducing escape-direction coherence within components.

elong_meso_component_aspect_ratio → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale A stretched component shape tends to align with a shared escape direction, raising the coherence of escape vectors.

elong_meso_component_aspect_ratio → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Elongation often reflects directional movement, so fish headings align along the major axis, increasing component polarization.

elong_meso_component_aspect_ratio → comp_meso_component_edge_density intra_scale Elongated components stretch fish apart along the major axis, lowering the fraction of possible contacts that are realized.

elong_meso_component_aspect_ratio → comp_meso_component_mean_nearest_distance intra_scale Stretching a component along one axis increases typical spacing between fish, raising the mean nearest-contact distance.

elong_meso_component_aspect_ratio → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale An anisotropic, stretched shape is incompatible with circular milling, so higher aspect ratio reduces rotational order.

elong_meso_component_escape_alignment → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale When a component's major axis is aligned with the mean escape direction, fish are arranged along the escape path, which can enhance the coherence of their escape vectors.

elong_meso_component_axis_length → comp_meso_component_edge_density intra_scale Elongation stretches a component and can reduce the number of realized contact edges relative to possible pairs, lowering edge density.

elong_meso_component_axis_length → comp_meso_component_mean_nearest_distance intra_scale A more elongated component shape can spread fish along its major axis, changing mean nearest-contact distance within the component.

elong_meso_component_axis_length → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale An elongated component geometry can weaken coherent tangential orientation around the component centroid, reducing rotational order.

wave_meso_component_escape_coherence → pol_meso_component_away_shark_alignment intra_scale Coherent escape directions generally point away from the threat, so higher escape-direction coherence should increase component heading alignment away from the shark.
wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Shared heading-escape alignment can support more coherent escape-direction vectors across component fish.

wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Component fish aligning their headings with escape directions can increase the resultant heading polarization within the component.

wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale Strong alignment toward escape directions can compete with tangential motion around the component centroid, reducing rotational order.

wave_meso_component_mean_escape_alignment → lead_meso_component_lagged_alignment intra_scale Escape-aligned component motion can make current heading changes more consistent with prior neighbor heading changes, altering lagged alignment.
wave_meso_component_turn_variance → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Heterogeneous requested turns within a component disrupt a shared escape direction and lower coherence.
wave_meso_component_turn_variance → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Turn heterogeneity reduces heading alignment, lowering component polarization.
wave_meso_component_turn_variance → pol_meso_component_mean_deviation intra_scale Dispersed turn requests increase angular spread of headings around the component mean.
wave_meso_component_turn_variance → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale Heterogeneous turns can disrupt coherent tangential directions needed for rotational order.
fright_meso_component_prevalence → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale More frightened component members can produce more aligned escape directions, raising component escape coherence.

fright_meso_component_prevalence → fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction intra_scale A higher fraction of frightened fish in a component increases the chance that within-component contact edges have both endpoints frightened.
fright_meso_component_prevalence → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Widespread fright can synchronize escape responses and increase heading polarization within the component.

fright_meso_component_prevalence → comp_meso_component_mean_nearest_distance intra_scale Fright responses can tighten or loosen local spacing, changing the mean nearest-contact distance in the component.

fright_meso_component_prevalence → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale High fright prevalence can disrupt coordinated tangential motion, reducing rotational order around the component centroid.
fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Frightened edges can synchronize escape directions among connected fish within a component.

fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction → fright_meso_component_prevalence intra_scale Frightened-frightened edges reflect and can reinforce local fright clustering, raising component fright prevalence.

fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction → fright_meso_component_fright_position_corr intra_scale Fright edges concentrate frightened fish in contact cores, altering the relation between fright and centroid distance.

fright_meso_component_fright_position_corr → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale When frightened fish are concentrated at the component periphery, their outward escape bias opposes group alignment, reducing polarization.
pol_meso_component_polarization → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Heading polarization supports a coherent sum of escape-direction vectors within the component.
pol_meso_component_polarization → pol_meso_component_away_shark_alignment intra_scale A polarized component heading can align with the away-from-shark direction under escape bias.
pol_meso_component_polarization → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale Strong linear heading polarization suppresses coherent tangential rotational ordering.
pol_meso_component_polarization → lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction intra_scale A polarized component makes sign-matched turn cascades more likely to appear.

pol_meso_component_away_shark_alignment → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Collective alignment away from the shark reinforces a common escape direction, which feeds back to increase escape-direction coherence.

comp_meso_component_edge_density → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Dense local contacts allow escape information to spread quickly, making escape directions more coherent across the component.
comp_meso_component_edge_density → fright_meso_component_prevalence intra_scale More contact edges facilitate social transmission of fright, raising the fraction of frightened fish in the component.

comp_meso_component_edge_density → fright_meso_component_fright_edge_fraction intra_scale Higher edge density increases the number of neighbor pairs, raising the chance that both endpoints are frightened and thus the frightened-edge fraction.
comp_meso_component_edge_density → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Denser contact networks provide more social alignment cues, increasing heading polarization within a component.
comp_meso_component_edge_density → pol_meso_component_mean_deviation intra_scale More contacts strengthen alignment pressure and reduce the angular spread of headings around the component mean.

comp_meso_component_edge_density → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale Dense local interactions can stabilize a coherent rotational flow, increasing rotational order within the component.

comp_meso_component_mean_degree → frag_meso_centroid_pair_distance intra_scale Components with higher internal mean degree are more cohesive, which tends to reduce spatial separation between component centroids and lower centroid-pair distance.

comp_meso_component_mean_degree → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Denser contact networks facilitate rapid transmission of escape information, leading to more coherent escape directions among component fish.

comp_meso_component_mean_degree → pol_meso_component_away_shark_alignment intra_scale A more connected component can more effectively coordinate collective heading away from a shark, increasing away-from-shark alignment.

comp_meso_component_mean_degree → mill_meso_component_angular_velocity intra_scale Higher internal connectivity can support coordinated rotational motion within a component, increasing its mean angular velocity.

comp_meso_component_mean_nearest_distance → comp_meso_component_edge_density intra_scale Larger mean nearest-contact spacing implies fewer close pairs and can lower realized contact edge density within the component.
comp_meso_component_mean_nearest_distance → comp_meso_component_mean_degree intra_scale Looser local spacing can reduce the number of contact neighbors per fish, lowering mean component degree.

comp_meso_component_mean_nearest_distance → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale Local spacing geometry affects whether fish move coherently tangentially around the component centroid, influencing rotational order.

mill_meso_component_angular_velocity → elong_meso_component_escape_alignment intra_scale Rotational motion alters the component's shape and orientation, which can change how its major axis aligns with the mean escape direction.

mill_meso_component_angular_velocity → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Strong milling motion creates competing tangential directions that can reduce the coherence of escape-direction vectors within the component.
mill_meso_component_rotational_order → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Milling-like rotational order can fragment escape directions, reducing component escape-direction coherence.

mill_meso_component_rotational_order → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Strong rotational order implies tangential headings that trade off with a single component-wide heading, lowering polarization.

mill_meso_component_rotational_order → mill_meso_component_angular_velocity intra_scale Coherent tangential orientation around a component centroid can sustain nonzero mean angular velocity of component fish.
mill_meso_component_angular_momentum → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Milling motion trades off with linear heading alignment, lowering component polarization.
mill_meso_component_angular_momentum → comp_meso_component_mean_nearest_distance intra_scale Rotational motion changes radial packing and thus mean nearest-contact spacing.
mill_meso_component_angular_momentum → mill_meso_component_rotational_order intra_scale Mean angular momentum indicates a common rotational sense, supporting rotational order.
lead_meso_component_lagged_alignment → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Lagged alignment of heading changes can reinforce shared component direction and increase component polarization.

lead_meso_component_lagged_alignment → lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction intra_scale When current component heading changes align with prior neighbor heading changes, sign-matched cascades across the component become more likely.
lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Cascades propagating a common turn can increase component escape-direction coherence.
lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale Sign-matched cascades can align component headings, raising polarization.
lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → lead_meso_component_influence_variance intra_scale Cascades concentrated in some fish create heterogeneity in lagged influence across the component.

lead_meso_component_influence_variance → wave_meso_component_escape_coherence intra_scale Uneven influence within a component can fragment the escape response, lowering the coherence of escape directions.

lead_meso_component_influence_variance → pol_meso_component_polarization intra_scale A component with highly variable influence among fish lacks a shared directional drive, reducing overall heading polarization.
frag_macro_component_count → frag_macro_largest_fraction intra_scale A larger number of contact components tends to reduce the share of fish in any single largest component.
frag_macro_component_count → wave_macro_school_escape_coherence intra_scale When the school is split into many components, escape directions across the whole school become less globally coherent.
frag_macro_component_count → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale Fragmentation into many components can reduce whole-school heading coherence, lowering global polarization.
frag_macro_component_count → comp_macro_school_mean_degree intra_scale More components imply fewer cross-group contacts and can lower the whole-school mean contact degree.

frag_macro_component_count → lead_macro_school_cascade_fraction intra_scale Fragmentation can block propagation of heading changes across the school, reducing whole-school sign-matched cascade fraction.
frag_macro_largest_fraction → wave_macro_school_escape_coherence intra_scale A smaller largest fraction implies fragmentation that weakens school-wide escape-direction coherence.
frag_macro_largest_fraction → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale A cohesive largest component can support global heading alignment and raise school polarization.
frag_macro_largest_fraction → comp_macro_school_mean_degree intra_scale A dominant connected component increases average contact degree across the school.

frag_macro_component_count_change → wave_macro_school_escape_coherence intra_scale When the school fragments into more components, escape directions are less shared across the whole group, reducing coherence.
frag_macro_component_count_change → fright_macro_school_prevalence intra_scale More components mean fewer inter-component contacts, slowing fright contagion and lowering overall fright prevalence.

frag_macro_component_count_change → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale An increase in the number of components indicates school splitting, which disrupts global heading alignment and lowers polarization.
frag_macro_component_count_change → comp_macro_school_clustering intra_scale Splitting into separate components reduces long-range triangles across the school, lowering global clustering.

frag_macro_component_count_change → comp_macro_school_mean_nearest_distance intra_scale More components imply greater separation between groups, increasing the average distance to the nearest contact neighbor.
frag_macro_component_count_change → mill_macro_school_angular_velocity intra_scale Fragmentation breaks the cohesive circular flow required for milling, reducing whole-school angular velocity.
elong_macro_school_aspect_ratio → frag_macro_largest_fraction intra_scale Strong elongation can stretch contact ranges and reduce the fish fraction in the largest component.
elong_macro_school_aspect_ratio → wave_macro_school_escape_coherence intra_scale An elongated school can channel escape directions along its major axis, affecting global escape coherence.
elong_macro_school_aspect_ratio → mill_macro_school_rotational_order intra_scale An elongated linear school shape suppresses coherent global rotational ordering.

elong_macro_anisotropy_index → frag_macro_component_count_change intra_scale Strong stretching increases inter-fish distances along the major axis, which can break contacts and increase the number of components.
elong_macro_anisotropy_index → wave_macro_school_escape_coherence intra_scale Anisotropic stretching aligns fish along a common escape axis, increasing whole-school escape-direction coherence.

elong_macro_anisotropy_index → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale A more elongated school often reflects directional movement, with headings aligned along the major axis, raising global polarization.

elong_macro_anisotropy_index → mill_macro_school_angular_velocity intra_scale A stretched, anisotropic school is incompatible with circular milling, so higher anisotropy reduces whole-school angular velocity.

wave_macro_school_escape_coherence → elong_macro_anisotropy_index intra_scale A coherent escape wave stretches the school along the escape direction, increasing anisotropy of the position distribution.

wave_macro_school_escape_coherence → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale When escape directions are highly coherent across the school, fish headings align with that shared direction, raising global polarization.
wave_macro_school_escape_coherence → mill_macro_school_angular_velocity intra_scale Coherent directional escape conflicts with rotational milling, reducing whole-school angular velocity.

wave_macro_heading_change_shark_cov → fright_macro_school_prevalence intra_scale Large heading changes near sharks indicate strong escape reactions that can trigger fright in nearby fish, raising school-wide fright prevalence.
wave_macro_escape_coherence_change → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale A rise in whole-school escape-direction coherence can coordinate headings and increase global polarization.
wave_macro_escape_coherence_change → pol_macro_polarization_change intra_scale Changes in escape-direction coherence can drive corresponding changes in whole-school heading polarization.

wave_macro_escape_coherence_change → lead_macro_school_cascade_fraction intra_scale A shift toward more coherent escape directions can synchronize heading changes and raise the sign-matched cascade fraction.

fright_macro_school_prevalence → elong_macro_major_escape_alignment intra_scale When many fish are frightened, the school tends to stretch along the common escape direction, aligning its major axis with escape.

fright_macro_school_prevalence → wave_macro_heading_change_shark_cov intra_scale Widespread fright amplifies escape turns, especially near sharks, strengthening the covariance between heading-change magnitude and shark proximity.
fright_macro_school_prevalence → comp_macro_school_mean_nearest_distance intra_scale Fright often induces defensive compaction, which reduces the mean nearest-neighbor distance across the school.
fright_macro_school_prevalence → mill_macro_school_rotational_order intra_scale Widespread fright disrupts coordinated rotational motion, lowering the school's rotational order.

fright_macro_school_fright_edge_fraction → fright_macro_school_prevalence intra_scale A high fraction of frightened-frightened contact edges can promote further social fright transmission, increasing whole-school fright prevalence.
fright_macro_school_fright_edge_fraction → fright_macro_onset_rate intra_scale Frightened edges provide channels for new fright onsets, so higher frightened-edge fraction can raise the onset rate.
fright_macro_school_fright_edge_fraction → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale Widespread frightened contact edges can synchronize escape headings across the school and increase polarization.
fright_macro_onset_rate → wave_macro_escape_coherence_change intra_scale A burst of fright onsets changes the school escape-direction coherence relative to the previous step.
fright_macro_onset_rate → fright_macro_school_prevalence intra_scale New fright onsets add frightened fish and raise whole-school fright prevalence.
fright_macro_onset_rate → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale Fright onset bursts trigger aligned escape responses, raising school polarization.
pol_macro_school_polarization → wave_macro_school_escape_coherence intra_scale A more polarized school heading can support more coherent escape directions across fish.

pol_macro_school_polarization → mill_macro_school_angular_momentum intra_scale Strong whole-school polarization implies aligned linear motion that trades off with sustained rotational angular momentum.
pol_macro_polarization_proximity_cov → pol_macro_school_polarization intra_scale Runs where polarization tracks shark proximity can exhibit higher polarization during threat periods.
